sources: steer.json of one run of steer_dose.py (measured for this page; not part of the repository)
steer_margins.safetensors of the same run (per-item margins, unrounded)

definition.margin: m = logsumexp(logits of line-break tokens) - logsumexp(logits of tokens that start with a space), at the last token of the text. Line-break tokens: tokens whose text contains a newline or carriage return and is otherwise whitespace. Higher m = the model predicts a line break.
definition.difference: For each arm, D = (a tensor X of the corrupt run, moved onto the clean run's token positions) - (X of the clean run), at every token position; zero where a clean position has no partner in the corrupt text.
definition.dose: A patched run is the clean text with one tensor replaced by: clean value + alpha x D. alpha is the dose. alpha = 0 is the clean run unchanged. alpha = 1 is the patch of demo/line_count.py. alpha < 0 or alpha > 1 extrapolates along the same straight line beyond the clean and the corrupt value; such a value was not produced by the model on any text.
definition.share: share(alpha) = mean over items of (m_clean - m_patched(alpha)) / mean over items of (m_clean - m_corrupt), the definition of demo/line_count.py. 0 = the patch changes nothing on average, 1 = on average the patch moves the margin as far as the corrupt text does. share_ci95 = its 2.5 % and 97.5 % bootstrap quantiles over items (1000 draws, the demonstration's seed).
